item.title: Re: Last Flight Out (SEEKING GREENLIGHT)
item.content:encoded: The central narrative is how you will tell this story, for example how the Foundation came to know of the anomaly, reports of researchers, explorers, or random people caught in the anomalous plane. Don't forget to think of containment procedures and other means to anchor it to the universe of the Foundation.

item.title: Last Flight Out (SEEKING GREENLIGHT)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article (Aiming for SCP-5127)

Elevator Pitch

  • Anomalous airplane
  • Appears at airports that are either closed, either for the night or due to bad weather
  • It's destination is always one in high demand at the current aiport
  • Up to 26 passengers can 'transfer' to this flight
  • Plane does not show up on radar, and does not recieve instruction from air traffic control
  • Flight always lasts 2 hours, 47 minutes from take off to landing
  • Will land in some forsaken place, such as in the middle of Siberia, the Sahara, or even in the ocean
  • Aiport it lands at is also anomalous, appearing from the inside to be an exact copy of whatever aiport the plane was supposed to land at
  • Airport will spontaneously generate about 30 minutes before the plane lands
  • Aiport will remain in existince for exactly 75 minutes, before both it and the airplane disappear

Central Narrative: Honestly I don't really understand what this part is supposed to mean, so for the the time being, I will say None. But please feel free to give me advice on what to put here, as well as how to expand and improve this SCP.
